properties.description: Italian cuisine emphasizes simplicity and quality of ingredients over elaborate preparation. Notable ingredients include tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, dark leafy greens, pasta, cheeses and various types of meats.
properties.history: Originating from the culinary traditions of the Roman Empire, Italian cuisine has profoundly influenced food culture around the globe and gained a reputation for quality, simplicity, and flavor.

properties.description: Italian music captures the diverse and rich culture of Italy. It includes various styles from opera to electronic music, and also encompasses traditional music that is unique to specific cities or regions in Italy.
properties.history: Italian music has been shaped through the centuries by various forms of art, including opera and sacred music. It has a rich and diverse history that spans from the ancient Roman Empire up until the modern day. It incorporates a diverse array of traditional music which is divided into 'Italian folk music', 'Classical music', 'Popular music' and 'Imported music'.
properties.performance: Solo, duet, operatic, orchestral, or choral performances are common
properties.rhythm: Varied rhythms, including tarantella, waltz, and mazurka
properties.vocals: Can be both instrumental and vocal. Opera and choral music feature prominently
